content.text: Show summary Hide summary 🔥 Quick Facts Air Time Breakdown Across Time Zones What To Expect In Season 3’s Premiere Episode Cast & Release Schedule Complete Grid How To Watch Tonight Without Cable Will Euphoria Season 3 Be The Final Season? Euphoria finally returns tonight, and the wait is over. The Emmy-nominated HBO drama premieres Sunday, April 12 at 9 PM ET/6 PM PT. Fans have been counting down since season 2’s finale, and the show’s third installment promises drama, unexpected twists, and adult storylines nobody anticipated. 🔥 Quick Facts Premiere Time: Tonight at 9 PM ET, 6 PM PT on HBO and HBO Max Total Episodes: Season 3 contains 8 weeks of new episodes airing every Sunday Season Finale: May 31, 2026 marks the end of the entire Euphoria series Release Schedule: New episodes drop weekly at 9 PM ET on HBO and stream immediately on HBO Max Air Time Breakdown Across Time Zones Mark your calendar for 9 PM Eastern Time tonight on HBO. If you’re West Coast, tune in at 6 PM Pacific Time. The moments the episode finishes airing on HBO, it becomes available to stream on HBO Max, so you don’t need cable. Central and Mountain viewers adjust accordingly from the 9 PM ET slot. HBO Max subscribers receive simultaneous access as soon as the premium cable broadcast finishes. No delayed streaming, no exclusivity windows. The entire first episode will be available instantly after the 9 PM ET premiere concludes. What To Expect In Season 3’s Premiere Episode Tonight’s episode, titled ‘Àndale,’ picks up years after season 2 ended. Cassie has transformed into an adult content creator living in the suburbs, now engaged to Nate. Their relationship appears stable on the surface, but Euphoria never delivers simple happiness. Meanwhile, Jules is attending art school while Lexi pursues a mysterious career path. Rue’s journey continues as the show explores whether recovery and redemption are possible after the chaos. Multiple interviews suggest tonight’s premiere contains shocking moments that reframe the entire series. Stream on HBO Max. Release date: Sunday, April 12. US time: 9pm ET / 6pm PT.” — TechRadar, Streaming Guide How To Watch Tonight Without Cable HBO Max subscribers gain instant access at the premiere moment without needing cable. Simply log into your HBO Max account and navigate to Euphoria at 9 PM ET. The show will appear in your feed moments after the live HBO broadcast concludes. If you don’t have HBO Max, DirecTV offers a free trial period. Cable subscribers can watch on HBO proper at 9 PM ET, then revisit the episode anytime on their HBO Max apps. All streaming happens in 1080p HD with no ads for premium subscribers. Will Euphoria Season 3 Be The Final Season? Yes, this is officially the last season of Euphoria. The May 31 series finale concludes the entire show’s story. Creator Sam Levinson designed season 3 as the ultimate conclusion, tying up character arcs across eight carefully planned episodes. Fans should expect finality tonight. This premiere sets the stage for goodbye, making it unmissable for anyone who invested years in these characters. The cast reunion at the red carpet premiere four days ago signaled the weight of this final chapter. Tonight airs what many are calling the show’s most mature, adult-focused season yet.
